_comment: Copy to revision_paths.json in D:\aquavisionnet\revision\ and fill in. Use double backslashes. Leave a value as "" if you do not have it yet - run_all.py will skip that model and say so instead of crashing. Confirm every path against results\00_inventory.md.
_comment_matched: Corpus used by the matched-protocol detectors. file_name entries inside these jsons are ABSOLUTE paths, so image_root can stay ".".
_comment_ckpts: Checkpoints already on disk. src is the folder holding fasterrcnn_baseline_standalone.py and avn_full_testsplit_standalone.py.
_comment_dino: The DINO extension. dino_ann_test is the annotation file DINO was evaluated against - run_all.py --stage check compares it against gt_test and stops if they are different splits.
_comment_audit_dir: Annotation folder used by the R1.6 leakage audit. Must be the set whose images carry a per-image "source" field (the aquatax10 annotations), otherwise the source attribution falls back to path matching.
_comment_tta: COCO results json produced by your own TTA+WBF script, run unchanged. run_all.py only copies them into results\preds. Leave empty until they exist.
_comment_audit: Legacy: output of the ORIGINAL pHash audit. No longer needed - stage "leakage" rebuilds the flagged list itself, using the same union rule (near-dup in train OR in val) that produced the published 45.
_comment_aug: SAM-augmented train json (2,159 images / 5,282 boxes) - only used for the box-count table and ablation row B2.
